gloss: ordering in; special order; mail order

definitions.gloss: ordering in; special order; having something sent
definitions.explanation: ordering a product that is not in stock to be brought in from another location or supplier

definitions.gloss: mail order; ordering goods for delivery
definitions.explanation: ordering products from a distant place, especially regional specialties or gourmet items, to be delivered

examples.japanese: {在庫|ざいこ}がないので{取|と}り{寄|よ}せになります。
examples.english: It's not in stock, so it will be a special order.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}は{取|と}り{寄|よ}せに{一週間|いっしゅうかん}かかります。
examples.english: It will take a week to order this book in.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}からカニを{取|と}り{寄|よ}せた。
examples.english: I ordered crab delivered from Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: お{取|と}り{寄|よ}せグルメが{最近|さいきん}{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: Mail-order gourmet food has been popular recently.

examples.japanese: {地方|ちほう}の{名産品|めいさんひん}を{取|と}り{寄|よ}せて{楽|たの}しむ。
examples.english: I enjoy ordering regional specialties to be delivered.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{寄|よ}せには{送料|そうりょう}がかかる{場合|ばあい}があります。
examples.english: There may be shipping charges for special orders.

notes:
FORMS:
{取|と}り{寄|よ}せる (to order, to send for) → {取|と}り{寄|よ}せ (noun form)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {取|と}り{寄|よ}せをする (to place a special order)
- お{取|と}り{寄|よ}せ (polite form, often for gourmet items)
- {取|と}り{寄|よ}せ{商品|しょうひん} (items available for order)

CULTURAL NOTE:
お{取|と}り{寄|よ}せ culture is popular in Japan, where people order regional delicacies from across the country. This has become even more common with online shopping.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{取|と}り{寄|よ}せグルメ (mail-order gourmet food)
- お{取|と}り{寄|よ}せスイーツ (mail-order sweets)
- {産地直送|さんちちょくそう}{取|と}り{寄|よ}せ (direct-from-producer orders)

RELATED WORDS:
- {取|と}り{置|お}き (holding/reserving an item)
